tabs.label: Overview
tabs.title: Twilio-compatible voice on wholesale carrier infrastructure.
tabs.description: Run compatible Programmable Voice workloads without rewriting call logic. Bring your own speech, storage, and AI vendors. Pay published carrier rates without platform markup.

tabs.label: VoiceML
tabs.title: VoiceML
tabs.description: Run your Twilio app on VoiceTel without rewriting code. Same <Say>, <Gather>, <Dial>, and <Record>. Compatible webhook signatures. Volume discounts your finance team will notice.

tabs.label: Voice & SIP
tabs.title: Voice
tabs.description: STIR/SHAKEN attestation. Global colocation footprint and cloud regions. US-based NOC. Bring your own STT, TTS, and recording storage — pay providers directly, no VoiceTel markup.

tabs.label: Messaging
tabs.eyebrow: SMS and MMS at wholesale rates
tabs.title: Messaging
tabs.description: A2P 10DLC for high-volume application messaging. Inbound included. Webhook delivery to your endpoint. No per-message platform tax.

tabs.label: Numbers
tabs.title: Numbers
tabs.description: Wholesale rates on every number type. Per-number e911 provisioning. CNAM and caller-ID services available. Port local, toll-free, and mobile numbers with coordinated cutover support.

tabs.label: AI Agents
tabs.title: AI Agents
tabs.description: Configure assistants with a model, instructions, tools, and knowledge resources. Connect voice sessions through VoiceML and inspect session history through the API.

tabs.label: SDN
tabs.title: SDN appliance
tabs.description: Place a Raspberry Pi in your LAN; it tunnels to VoiceTel core. Solves NAT, ALG, UDP timer, and firewall misconfiguration without changing your routing policies.

tabs.label: Phone apps
tabs.title: Phone apps
tabs.description: VoIP calling on web (no install), Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. WebRTC media. One app, three form factors.

tabs.label: Pricing
tabs.title: Pricing
tabs.description: Every line item published. No 'contact sales' gates. STT, TTS, and recording storage paid directly to your chosen provider with zero VoiceTel markup.

tabs.label: Docs
tabs.title: Documentation
tabs.description: VoiceML reference, REST API, integration guides for major PBX platforms and firewall vendors, and a five-minute migrate-from-Twilio playbook.
